He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama Crimson Tide]]. ==High school career== Primo played basketball for [[Huntington Prep School]] in [[Huntington, West Virginia]], where he was teammates with [[JT Thor]].{{cite web|first=Erik|last=Hall|title=Joshua Primo: 4 things to know about the Alabama men's basketball guard|url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/2021/02/04/joshua-primo-facts-alabama-mens-basketball-guard/4397972001/|work=[[The Tuscaloosa News]]|date=February 4, 2021|access-date=May 13, 2021}} He transferred to Royal Crown Academic School in [[Scarborough, Toronto]].{{cite web|first=Mickias|last=Mikre|title=Joshua Primo Returns to Canada, Commits to Royal Crown|url=https://northpolehoops.com/2020/01/10/joshua-primo-returns-to-canada-commits-to-royal-crown/|website=NorthPoleHoops.com|date=January 10, 2020|access-date=May 13, 2021}} Primo [[reclassification (education)|reclassified]] to the 2020 class and graduated early.{{cite web|first=Joey|last=Blackwell|title=Freshman Guard Josh Primo Already Developing into Solid Contributor for Alabama Basketball|url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/bamacentral/josh-primo-already-contributing-for-alabama-basketball-blackwell|work=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=December 11, 2020|access-date=May 13, 2021}} Considered a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[247Sports]], he committed to playing college basketball for [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]], choosing the Crimson Tide over [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton]].{{cite web|first=Hank|last=South|title=Five-star guard Josh Primo signs with Alabama|url=https://247sports.com/college/alabama/Article/Alabama-Basketball-Recruiting-Five-star-guard-Josh-Primo-signs-with-Tide-Nate-Oats--146078782/|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=April 15, 2020|access-date=May 13, 2021}} ==College career== In his freshman season, Primo was the youngest player in college basketball. He averaged 8.1 points and 3.4 rebounds per game and was named to the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) All-Freshman Team.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|title=Alabama's Joshua Primo to enter NBA draft but stay eligible to return to Crimson Tide|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31300916|work=[[ESPN]]|date=April 21, 2021|access-date=May 13, 2021}} Primo missed three games with a left [[medial collateral ligament]] sprain.{{cite web|first=Josh|last=Vitale|title=Alabama basketball 'hoping' Joshua Primo can play in NCAA Tournament|url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/03/14/joshua-primo-injury-alabama-basketball-nate-oats-ncaa-tournament-2021/4696316001/|website=[[The Tuscaloosa News]]|date=March 14, 2021|access-date=May 13, 2021}} On April 21, 2021, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web|title=Alabama guard Josh Primo makes NBA Draft decision|url=https://www.saturdaydownsouth.com/alabama-football/nba-draft-josh-primo-crimson-tide-basketball/|website=SaturdayDownSouth.com|date=April 21, 2021|access-date=May 13, 2021}} However, on June 30, Primo announced he would remain in the draft due to a strong performance at the [[NBA Draft Combine]].{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|title=Alabama's Joshua Primo, projected first-round pick, opts to stay in NBA draft|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/31741140|website=[[ESPN]]|date=June 30, 2020|access-date=July 1, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===San Antonio Spurs (2021–2022)=== Primo was selected with the 12th pick in the [[2021 NBA draft]] by the [[San Antonio Spurs]].{{cite news|first=Mark|last=Inabinett|title=Josh Primo: 'I don't know if I was ready for that'|url=https://www.al.com/sports/2021/07/josh-primo-i-dont-know-if-i-was-ready-for-that.html|website=[[Al.com]]|date=July 30, 2021|access-date=July 30, 2021}}{{cite web|first=Ezekiel|last=Mauricio|title=SPURS SELECT JOSHUA PRIMO AND JOE WIESKAMP IN 2021 NBA DRAFT|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-select-joshua-primo-and-joe-wieskamp-2021-nba-draft|website=NBA.com|date=July 29, 2021|access-date=July 31, 2021}} Primo was later included in the 2021 NBA Summer League roster of the Spurs.{{cite web|first=Ezekiel|last=Mauricio|title=Spurs announce 2021 Summer League roster|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-announce-2021-summer-league-roster|website=NBA.com|date=August 1, 2021|access-date=August 1, 2021}} On August 11, 2021, the [[San Antonio Spurs]] announced that they had signed Primo.{{cite web|first=Ezekiel|last=Mauricio|title=Spurs sign 2021 first round pick Josh Primo|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-2021-first-round-pick-josh-primo|website=NBA.com|date=August 11, 2021|access-date=August 11, 2021}} On October 20, Primo made his NBA debut, coming off the bench in the final five minutes with three points in a 123–97 win over the [[2021–22 Orlando Magic season|Orlando Magic]]. Primo was the youngest player who attended college to play in the NBA.{{cite web|title=Vassell, Walker lead balanced Spurs past Magic, 123-97|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401359839|website=ESPN.com|date=October 20, 2021|access-date=October 20, 2021}} On October 27, Primo received his first assignment to the [[Austin Spurs]].{{cite web|first=Ezekiel|last=Mauricio|title=San Antonio assigns Josh Primo to Austin Spurs|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/san-antonio-assigns-josh-primo-austin-spurs|website=NBA.com|date=October 27, 2021|access-date=October 27, 2021}} Primo was the youngest player in the league during the 2021–22 season.{{cite tweet|first=Darren|last=Rovell|title=Youngest player in the NBA: Josh Primo, who was 5 months old when David Robinson retired in June 2003.|number=1450959182799196164|user=darrenrovell|date=October 20, 2021|access-date=October 20, 2021}} ===Los Angeles Clippers (2023–2024)=== On September 29, 2023, the NBA suspended Primo for four games without pay on the grounds that he had exposed himself to women.{{cite web|title=NBA suspends Joshua Primo 4 games without pay|url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-suspends-joshua-primo-4-games|website=NBA.com|date=September 29, 2023|access-date=September 29, 2023}} Later that day, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Clippers Sign Joshua Primo To Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/09/clippers-to-sign-joshua-primo-to-two-way-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 29, 2023|access-date=September 29, 2023}} On November 15, the Clippers converted Primo's two-way contract to a standard contract.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Clippers Officially Promote Joshua Primo To Standard Roster|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/11/clippers-officially-promote-joshua-primo-to-standard-roster.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=November 15, 2023|access-date=November 16, 2023}} However, on April 13, 2024, he was waived by the Clippers.{{cite tweet|author=LA Clippers|title=Thank you, Josh ❤️💙|number=1779231484253282644|user=LAClippers|date=April 13, 2024|access-date=April 13, 2024}} On October 2, 2024, Primo signed with the [[Chicago Bulls]], but was waived the next day.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Bulls Sign, Waive Joshua Primo |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/bulls-sign-joshua-primo-to-exhibit-10-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 3, 2024|access-date=October 4, 2024}} On October 28, he joined the [[Windy City Bulls]],{{cite web|title=Windy City Bulls Announce 2024-25 Training Camp Roster|url=https://windycity.gleague.nba.com/news/windy-city-bulls-announce-2024-25-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=October 30, 2024}} but was waived on December 29 without playing in a game for the team.{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Windy City Bulls Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Windy-City-Bulls/44/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 30, 2024}} === BC Parma (2026–present) === On September 1, 2026, Primo was signed by [[BC Parma]] of the [[VTB United League]].{{Cite web |date=2026-09-01 |title=Joshua Primo has joined Betcity Parma |url=https://vtb-league.com/en/news/joshua-primo-parma/ |access-date=2026-09-01 |website=VTB United League |language=en}} ==National team career== Primo represented [[Canada men's national under-19 basketball team|Canada]] at the [[2019 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]] in Greece. At age 16, he was the youngest player on the team and averaged 4.2 points per game.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|title=Canadian prospect Josh Primo commits to Alabama|url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/28962200|website=ESPN.com|date=March 27, 2020|access-date=May 13, 2021}}{{cite web|first=Jordan|last=Harper|title=Getting to know Alabama basketball target Josh Primo|url=https://alabama.rivals.com/news/getting-to-know-alabama-basketball-target-josh-primo|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=February 20, 2020|access-date=May 13, 2021}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Regular season==== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2021}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 San Antonio Spurs season|San Antonio]] | '''50''' || '''16''' || 19.3 || '''.374''' || '''.307''' || .746 || 2.3 || 1.6 || '''.4''' || '''.5''' || 5.8 |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2022}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022–23 San Antonio Spurs season|San Antonio]] | 4 || 0 || '''23.3''' || .346 || .250 || '''.778''' || '''3.3''' || '''4.5''' || .3 || '''.5''' || '''7.0''' |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2023}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023–24 Los Angeles Clippers season|L.A. Primo's older sister, Keshia, played college basketball at the [[Buffalo Bulls women's basketball|University at Buffalo]], [[Coffeyville Community College]], and [[Southern Connecticut State University]]. === Indecent exposure allegations === Primo was waived by the Spurs on October 28, 2022.{{cite web|first=Landon|last=Pederson|title=Spurs Waive Joshua Primo|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-waive-joshua-primo|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2022|access-date=October 28, 2022}} In a statement released by ESPN through [[Adrian Wojnarowski]], he stated that he was seeking mental health treatment due to a "previous trauma".{{cite web|first=Ryan|last=Young|title=Spurs waive 2021 lottery pick Joshua Primo, who says he is focusing on 'mental health treatment'|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/joshua-primo-the-no-12-overall-pick-in-2021-waived-by-spurs-233436983.html|work=Yahoo Sports|date=October 29, 2022|access-date=October 29, 2022}} The next day, it was revealed that Primo allegedly exposed himself to several women.{{cite web|first1=Ramona|last1=Shelburne|author-link1=Ramona Shelburne|first2=Adrian|last2=Wojnarowski|author-link2=Adrian Wojnarowski|name-list-style=and|title=Sources: Joshua Primo allegedly exposed himself to women|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/34904011|website=ESPN.com|date=October 29, 2022|access-date=October 29, 2022}} In November, the Spurs' sports psychologist filed a lawsuit against Primo and the team, alleging that Primo had exposed himself to her multiple times.{{cite news|first=Kirstie|last=Rieken|title=Canadian Josh Primo, San Antonio Spurs sued by former team psychologist|url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/basketball/nba/joshua-primo-nba-san-antonio-spurs-allegations-of-exposure-sued-1.6639611|website=CBC.ca|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 4, 2022}} Primo's lawyer then released a statement which denied any wrongdoing, asserting that any exposure was unwitting and that the accuser was not acting in good faith.{{cite web|first=Kristie|last=Rieken|title=Josh Primo, Spurs sued by former team psychologist|url=https://apnews.com/article/san-antonio-spurs-nba-sports-lawsuits-houston-513dbdc8302dfe8d15b6fc4abcc91df1|website=APNews.com|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 5, 2022}} On December 8, 2023, District Attorney Joe Gonzales announced his office would not bring charges of indecent exposure against Primo due to insufficient evidence.{{cite web|first1=Kolten|last1=Parker|first2=Ben|last2=Spicer|title=Former Spurs guard Josh Primo will not be charged by Bexar County District Attorney Joe Gonzales|url=https://www.ksat.com/news/local/2023/12/08/former-spurs-guard-josh-primo-will-not-be-charged-by-bexar-county-district-attorney-joe-gonzales/|website=KSAT.com|date=December 8,
